---
title: F100 to F110 forward laser intent fixture
---

This disposable two-stage fixture prepares a fresh current MIR5 F100 5.0.10000 source save, earns `laser-turret-speed-8` at the explicit 75-percent setting and finite cap eight, then upgrades it to current MIR5 F110 5.0.11000 where the packaged `5.0.11000` JSON mapping must expose `laser-shooting-speed-8` at cap forty. It is a forward MIR5 cross-edition intent check, not a claim that the protected published4.7.10003 mining save contains a laser state, a release verdict, or a whole-catalogue migration result.

The source has one real finite laser lab, a separately retained 42-percent braking-force queue, a detached 27-percent laser progress force, a disabled foreign laser force and a second unearned control force. The successor verifies all of those before creating its own lab, earns exactly one additional canonical laser level, restores the queue, saves, then reports two read-only cold reloads. The fixture reads only its own `global.mir5_f100_f110_laser_transition` key and never reads or writes MIR storage.

Source and successor use the same fixture name with versions0.1.0 and0.2.0, respectively. Their data-stage checks validate the named identity, finite cap, single gun-speed effect, five science packs and the unaccelerated formula/time before changing only the direct lab to count/time one. Native execution, selected archive composition and resource admission remain separate work.
